New cleaned version of the excel file

```{r}
complete_data_clean <- complete_data[-1, ] %>%
  dplyr::select(
    provincia = ...2,
    fdi = ...12,
    lega = ...13,
    prrp = ...14,
    turnout = ...15

  mutate(
    provincia = toupper(provincia),
    fdi = as.numeric(gsub("%", "", fdi)),

    prrp = as.numeric(gsub("%", "", prrp)),
    turnout = as.numeric(gsub("%", "", turnout))
  )

glimpse(complete_data_clean)
```

```{r}
complete_data_clean <- complete_data_clean %>%

      provincia == "MASSA CARRARA" ~ "MASSA-CARRARA",
      TRUE ~ provincia
    )
```

## Interactive map simple

```{r}

# 1. Read original province / metropolitan city shapefile
prov_shape_original <- st_read(
  "~/Desktop/Data Science/R & Stats/Dati_geografici/Limiti01012024/ProvCM01012024/ProvCM01012024_WGS84.shp"
)

# 2. Clean names in the electoral dataset so that they match the shapefile
complete_data_clean <- complete_data_clean %>%
  mutate(
    provincia = case_when(
      provincia == "FORLÌ-CESENA" ~ "FORLI'-CESENA",
      provincia == "MASSA-CARRARA" ~ "MASSA CARRARA",
      TRUE ~ provincia
    )
  )

# 3. Prepare a separate shapefile object for the interactive map
# create a copy of the shapefile to avoid modifying the original object
prov_shape_interactive <- prov_shape_original %>%
  mutate(DEN_UTS = toupper(DEN_UTS))

# 4. Join shapefile + electoral data
map_prov_interactive <- prov_shape_interactive %>%
  left_join(complete_data_clean, by = c("DEN_UTS" = "provincia"))

# 5. Transform CRS to longitude / latitude for Leaflet
# transform coordinates to WGS84 (latitudine-longitudine) because Leaflet does not support UTM (metriche)
map_prov_leaflet <- st_transform(map_prov_interactive, 4326)

# 6. Create color palette based on PRRP vote share
# In leaflet, color direction is controlled with rev(), not direction = 1 (ggplot only)
pal_prrp <- colorNumeric(
  palette = "BuPu",
  domain = map_prov_leaflet$prrp
)

# 7. Interactive choropleth map
leaflet(map_prov_leaflet) %>%
  # NOTE (Sept 2026): CARTO now requires a free API key for its basemap tiles,
  # so anonymous requests come back stamped "API KEY REQUIRED". Verified by fetching
  # a tile directly with curl, outside any of these files: the watermark is baked in
  # by CARTO's own server.
  # The original line below is deliberately left untouched.
  #
  # Positron packed grey canvas + borders + place names into one tile layer.
  # Esri splits them in two, so the keyless replacement needs BOTH, in this order:
  #   addProviderTiles("Esri.WorldGrayCanvas")    %>%   # grey canvas
  #   addProviderTiles("Esri.WorldGrayReference") %>%   # borders and place names
  # Using only the first gives a blank grey field with no names: that is what the
  # first attempt looked like.
  #
  # The three saved .html maps were patched this way without re-rendering. See
  # leaflet-providers_2.0.0.js in each *_files folder; the CARTO original sits next
  # to it as .originale_carto.
  #
  # Avoid plain addTiles() / OpenStreetMap here: it draws roads, terrain and forests,
  # which fight with a choropleth. Esri's grey canvas keeps the data in front.
  addProviderTiles("CartoDB.Positron") %>%
  addPolygons(
    fillColor = ~pal_prrp(prrp),
    weight = 1,
    color = "white",
    fillOpacity = 0.8,
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<strong>", DEN_UTS, "</strong><br/>",
      "Turnout: ", round(turnout * 100, 1), "%<br/>",
      "FDI: ", round(fdi * 100, 1), "%<br/>",
      "Lega: ", round(lega * 100, 1), "%<br/>",
      "PRRP: ", round(prrp * 100, 1), "%"
    )
  ) %>%
  addLegend(
    pal = pal_prrp,
    values = ~prrp,
    title = "PRRP vote share",
    position = "bottomright"
  )
```

## Another switching map: PRRP, Turnout, Lega, FDI across Italian provinces and metropolitan cities with legends

```{r}
#| eval: false
```
```{r}
# in html file output this type of switching map is too heavy but I saved the definitive version with the legends

# transform coordinates to WGS84 (latitudine-longitudine) because Leaflet does not support UTM (metriche)
map_prov_leaflet <- st_transform(map_prov_interactive, 4326)

# helper function: create legend HTML with manual breaks
make_legend_html <- function(title, pal, bins) {
  mids <- (bins[-1] + bins[-length(bins)]) / 2
  cols <- pal(mids)

  labels <- paste0(
    round(bins[-length(bins)] * 100, 0), "% – ",
    round(bins[-1] * 100, 0), "%"
  )

  rows <- paste0(
    "<div style='display:flex; align-items:center; margin-bottom:4px;'>",
    "<span style='display:inline-block; width:18px; height:12px; background:",
    cols,
    "; margin-right:8px; border:1px solid #999;'></span>",
    "<span>", labels, "</span>",
    "</div>",
    collapse = ""
  )

  paste0(
    "<div style='background:white; padding:10px 12px; border-radius:6px; ",
    "box-shadow:0 1px 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); font-size:13px;'>",
    "<div style='font-weight:600; margin-bottom:8px;'>", title, "</div>",
    rows,
    "</div>"
  )
}

# palettes
pal_prrp <- colorNumeric("BuPu", domain = map_prov_leaflet$prrp)
pal_turnout <- colorNumeric("OrRd", domain = map_prov_leaflet$turnout)
pal_fdi <- colorNumeric("PuBu", domain = map_prov_leaflet$fdi)
pal_lega <- colorNumeric("BuGn", domain = map_prov_leaflet$lega)

# manual breaks
# min & max automatically detect the lower % in the map per category prrp, turnout, fdi, lega
bins_prrp <- c(
  min(map_prov_leaflet$prrp, na.rm = TRUE),
  0.30, 0.40, 0.50,
  max(map_prov_leaflet$prrp, na.rm = TRUE)
)

bins_turnout <- c(
  min(map_prov_leaflet$turnout, na.rm = TRUE),
  0.40, 0.50, 0.60,
  max(map_prov_leaflet$turnout, na.rm = TRUE)
)

bins_fdi <- c(
  min(map_prov_leaflet$fdi, na.rm = TRUE),
  0.22, 0.29, 0.36,
  max(map_prov_leaflet$fdi, na.rm = TRUE)
)

bins_lega <- c(
  min(map_prov_leaflet$lega, na.rm = TRUE),
  0.10, 0.15, 0.20,
  max(map_prov_leaflet$lega, na.rm = TRUE)
)

# pre-build legends
legend_list <- list(
  Turnout = make_legend_html("Turnout share", pal_turnout, bins_turnout),
  PRRP = make_legend_html("PRRP vote share", pal_prrp, bins_prrp),
  FDI = make_legend_html("FDI vote share", pal_fdi, bins_fdi),
  Lega = make_legend_html("Lega vote share", pal_lega, bins_lega)
)

map_layers_dynamic <- leaflet(map_prov_leaflet) %>%
  # NOTE (Sept 2026): CARTO now requires a free API key for its basemap tiles,
  # so anonymous requests come back stamped "API KEY REQUIRED". Verified by fetching
  # a tile directly with curl, outside any of these files: the watermark is baked in
  # by CARTO's own server.
  # The original line below is deliberately left untouched.
  #
  # Positron packed grey canvas + borders + place names into one tile layer.
  # Esri splits them in two, so the keyless replacement needs BOTH, in this order:
  #   addProviderTiles("Esri.WorldGrayCanvas")    %>%   # grey canvas
  #   addProviderTiles("Esri.WorldGrayReference") %>%   # borders and place names
  # Using only the first gives a blank grey field with no names: that is what the
  # first attempt looked like.
  #
  # The three saved .html maps were patched this way without re-rendering. See
  # leaflet-providers_2.0.0.js in each *_files folder; the CARTO original sits next
  # to it as .originale_carto.
  #
  # Avoid plain addTiles() / OpenStreetMap here: it draws roads, terrain and forests,
  # which fight with a choropleth. Esri's grey canvas keeps the data in front.
  addProviderTiles("CartoDB.Positron") %>%

  addPolygons(
    fillColor = ~pal_prrp(prrp),
    weight = 1,
    color = "white",
    fillOpacity = 0.8,
    group = "PRRP",
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<strong>", DEN_UTS, "</strong><br/>",
      "Turnout: ", round(turnout * 100, 1), "%<br/>",
      "FDI: ", round(fdi * 100, 1), "%<br/>",
      "Lega: ", round(lega * 100, 1), "%<br/>",
      "PRRP: ", round(prrp * 100, 1), "%"
    )
  ) %>%

  addPolygons(
    fillColor = ~pal_turnout(turnout),
    weight = 1,
    color = "white",
    fillOpacity = 0.8,
    group = "Turnout",
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<strong>", DEN_UTS, "</strong><br/>",
      "Turnout: ", round(turnout * 100, 1), "%<br/>",
      "FDI: ", round(fdi * 100, 1), "%<br/>",
      "Lega: ", round(lega * 100, 1), "%<br/>",
      "PRRP: ", round(prrp * 100, 1), "%"
    )
  ) %>%

  addPolygons(
    fillColor = ~pal_fdi(fdi),
    weight = 1,
    color = "white",
    fillOpacity = 0.8,
    group = "FDI",
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<strong>", DEN_UTS, "</strong><br/>",
      "Turnout: ", round(turnout * 100, 1), "%<br/>",
      "FDI: ", round(fdi * 100, 1), "%<br/>",
      "Lega: ", round(lega * 100, 1), "%<br/>",
      "PRRP: ", round(prrp * 100, 1), "%"
    )
  ) %>%

  addPolygons(
    fillColor = ~pal_lega(lega),
    weight = 1,
    color = "white",
    fillOpacity = 0.8,
    group = "Lega",
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<strong>", DEN_UTS, "</strong><br/>",
      "Turnout: ", round(turnout * 100, 1), "%<br/>",
      "FDI: ", round(fdi * 100, 1), "%<br/>",
      "Lega: ", round(lega * 100, 1), "%<br/>",
      "PRRP: ", round(prrp * 100, 1), "%"
    )
  ) %>%

  addLayersControl(
    baseGroups = c("Turnout", "PRRP", "FDI", "Lega"),
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  ) %>%

  hideGroup(c("PRRP", "FDI", "Lega")) %>%

  addControl(
    html = legend_list$Turnout,
    position = "bottomright",
    className = "dynamic-legend"
  ) %>% #The %>% (pipe operator) passes the output of one function directly into the next,
# allowing you to chain multiple operations in a clear, readable, step-by-step workflow.

  onRender(
    "
    function(el, x, data) {
      var map = this;
      var legend = document.querySelector('.dynamic-legend');

      function updateLegend(groupName) {
        if (legend && data.legends[groupName]) {
          legend.innerHTML = data.legends[groupName];
        }
      }

      updateLegend('Turnout');

      map.on('baselayerchange', function(e) {
        updateLegend(e.name);
      });
    }
    ",
    data = list(legends = legend_list)
  )

# This version uses one single legend container and updates its HTML dynamically
# when the active layer changes, so the legend always matches the selected variable.

# Manual breaks are used instead of automatic pretty() intervals
# to keep the legend cleaner and more consistent with the actual map colors.
```

```{r}
#| eval: false
# This block is kept as documentation, not run at render time.
# interactive_map_final.html is a heavy, pre-built artifact stored next to this file:
# rendering must never overwrite it. Run this chunk by hand to rebuild it.
library(htmlwidgets)
```

# Rome maps

```{r}
#| eval: false
# Not run at render time. This chunk needs prrp_by_comune_map, turnout_by_comune_map,
# fdi_by_comune_map and lega_by_comune_map, which are built by
# New_Applied_Rome_RProject.qmd, not by this file. Run that project first,
# then run this chunk by hand to rebuild the Rome map.
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(leaflet)
library(htmlwidgets)
library(htmltools)

# 1) Keep only the municipalities of the Metropolitan City of Rome
roma_prrp_sf <- prrp_by_comune_map %>%
  filter(COD_PROV == 58) %>%
  select(COD_PROV, COMUNE, join_name, prrp_vote_share_pct, geometry)

roma_turnout_sf <- turnout_by_comune_map %>%
  filter(COD_PROV == 58) %>%
  select(COD_PROV, COMUNE, join_name, turnout_pct, geometry)

roma_fdi_sf <- fdi_by_comune_map %>%
  filter(COD_PROV == 58) %>%
  select(COD_PROV, COMUNE, join_name, vote_share_pct, geometry) %>%
  rename(fdi_vote_share_pct = vote_share_pct)

roma_lega_sf <- lega_by_comune_map %>%
  filter(COD_PROV == 58) %>%
  select(COD_PROV, COMUNE, join_name, vote_share_pct, geometry) %>%
  rename(lega_vote_share_pct = vote_share_pct)

# 2) Join the four layers into one sf object
roma_interactive_map <- roma_turnout_sf %>%
  left_join(
    st_drop_geometry(roma_prrp_sf) %>%
      select(join_name, prrp_vote_share_pct),
    by = "join_name"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    st_drop_geometry(roma_fdi_sf) %>%
      select(join_name, fdi_vote_share_pct),
    by = "join_name"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    st_drop_geometry(roma_lega_sf) %>%
      select(join_name, lega_vote_share_pct),
    by = "join_name"
  ) %>%
  st_as_sf()

# 3) Convert percentages to proportions for leaflet legend control
roma_interactive_map <- roma_interactive_map %>%
  mutate(
    turnout = turnout_pct / 100,
    prrp = prrp_vote_share_pct / 100,
    fdi = fdi_vote_share_pct / 100,
    lega = lega_vote_share_pct / 100
  )

# 4) Transform coordinates to WGS84 for Leaflet
roma_interactive_leaflet <- st_transform(roma_interactive_map, 4326)

# 5) Helper function for dynamic legends
make_legend_html <- function(title, pal, bins) {
  mids <- (bins[-1] + bins[-length(bins)]) / 2
  cols <- pal(mids)

  labels <- paste0(
    round(bins[-length(bins)] * 100, 0), "% – ",
    round(bins[-1] * 100, 0), "%"
  )

  rows <- paste0(
    "<div style='display:flex; align-items:center; margin-bottom:4px;'>",
    "<span style='display:inline-block; width:18px; height:12px; background:",
    cols,
    "; margin-right:8px; border:1px solid #999;'></span>",
    "<span>", labels, "</span>",
    "</div>",
    collapse = ""
  )

  paste0(
    "<div style='background:white; padding:10px 12px; border-radius:6px; ",
    "box-shadow:0 1px 5px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); font-size:13px;'>",
    "<div style='font-weight:600; margin-bottom:8px;'>", title, "</div>",
    rows,
    "</div>"
  )
}

# 6) Palettes
pal_turnout_roma <- colorNumeric(
  "OrRd",
  domain = roma_interactive_leaflet$turnout,
  na.color = "#d9d9d9"
)

pal_prrp_roma <- colorNumeric(
  "BuPu",
  domain = roma_interactive_leaflet$prrp,
  na.color = "#d9d9d9"
)

pal_fdi_roma <- colorNumeric(
  "PuBu",
  domain = roma_interactive_leaflet$fdi,
  na.color = "#d9d9d9"
)

pal_lega_roma <- colorNumeric(
  "BuGn",
  domain = roma_interactive_leaflet$lega,
  na.color = "#d9d9d9"
)

# 7) Manual breaks
bins_turnout_roma <- c(
  min(roma_interactive_leaflet$turnout, na.rm = TRUE),
  0.45, 0.55, 0.65,
  max(roma_interactive_leaflet$turnout, na.rm = TRUE)
)

bins_prrp_roma <- c(
  min(roma_interactive_leaflet$prrp, na.rm = TRUE),
  0.20, 0.30, 0.40,
  max(roma_interactive_leaflet$prrp, na.rm = TRUE)
)

bins_fdi_roma <- c(
  min(roma_interactive_leaflet$fdi, na.rm = TRUE),
  0.15, 0.25, 0.35,
  max(roma_interactive_leaflet$fdi, na.rm = TRUE)
)

bins_lega_roma <- c(
  min(roma_interactive_leaflet$lega, na.rm = TRUE),
  0.03, 0.06, 0.09,
  max(roma_interactive_leaflet$lega, na.rm = TRUE)
)

# 8) Dynamic legend list
legend_list_roma <- list(
  Turnout = make_legend_html("Turnout share", pal_turnout_roma, bins_turnout_roma),
  PRRP = make_legend_html("PRRP vote share", pal_prrp_roma, bins_prrp_roma),
  FDI = make_legend_html("FDI vote share", pal_fdi_roma, bins_fdi_roma),
  Lega = make_legend_html("Lega vote share", pal_lega_roma, bins_lega_roma)
)

# 9) Interactive leaflet map
roma_layers_dynamic <- leaflet(roma_interactive_leaflet) %>%
  # NOTE (Sept 2026): CARTO now requires a free API key for its basemap tiles,
  # so anonymous requests come back stamped "API KEY REQUIRED". Verified by fetching
  # a tile directly with curl, outside any of these files: the watermark is baked in
  # by CARTO's own server.
  # The original line below is deliberately left untouched.
  #
  # Positron packed grey canvas + borders + place names into one tile layer.
  # Esri splits them in two, so the keyless replacement needs BOTH, in this order:
  #   addProviderTiles("Esri.WorldGrayCanvas")    %>%   # grey canvas
  #   addProviderTiles("Esri.WorldGrayReference") %>%   # borders and place names
  # Using only the first gives a blank grey field with no names: that is what the
  # first attempt looked like.
  #
  # The three saved .html maps were patched this way without re-rendering. See
  # leaflet-providers_2.0.0.js in each *_files folder; the CARTO original sits next
  # to it as .originale_carto.
  #
  # Avoid plain addTiles() / OpenStreetMap here: it draws roads, terrain and forests,
  # which fight with a choropleth. Esri's grey canvas keeps the data in front.
  addProviderTiles("CartoDB.Positron") %>%

  addPolygons(
    fillColor = ~pal_turnout_roma(turnout),
    weight = 1,
    color = "white",
    fillOpacity = 0.8,
    group = "Turnout",
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<strong>", COMUNE, "</strong><br/>",
      "Turnout: ", round(turnout * 100, 1), "%<br/>",
      "PRRPs: ", round(prrp * 100, 1), "%<br/>",
      "FDI: ", round(fdi * 100, 1), "%<br/>",
      "Lega: ", round(lega * 100, 1), "%"
    )
  ) %>%

  addPolygons(
    fillColor = ~pal_prrp_roma(prrp),
    weight = 1,
    color = "white",
    fillOpacity = 0.8,
    group = "PRRP",
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<strong>", COMUNE, "</strong><br/>",
      "Turnout: ", round(turnout * 100, 1), "%<br/>",
      "PRRPs: ", round(prrp * 100, 1), "%<br/>",
      "FDI: ", round(fdi * 100, 1), "%<br/>",
      "Lega: ", round(lega * 100, 1), "%"
    )
  ) %>%

  addPolygons(
    fillColor = ~pal_fdi_roma(fdi),
    weight = 1,
    color = "white",
    fillOpacity = 0.8,
    group = "FDI",
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<strong>", COMUNE, "</strong><br/>",
      "Turnout: ", round(turnout * 100, 1), "%<br/>",
      "PRRPs: ", round(prrp * 100, 1), "%<br/>",
      "FDI: ", round(fdi * 100, 1), "%<br/>",
      "Lega: ", round(lega * 100, 1), "%"
    )
  ) %>%

  addPolygons(
    fillColor = ~pal_lega_roma(lega),
    weight = 1,
    color = "white",
    fillOpacity = 0.8,
    group = "Lega",
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<strong>", COMUNE, "</strong><br/>",
      "Turnout: ", round(turnout * 100, 1), "%<br/>",
      "PRRPs: ", round(prrp * 100, 1), "%<br/>",
      "FDI: ", round(fdi * 100, 1), "%<br/>",
      "Lega: ", round(lega * 100, 1), "%"
    )
  ) %>%

  addLayersControl(
    baseGroups = c("Turnout", "PRRP", "FDI", "Lega"),
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  ) %>%

  hideGroup(c("PRRP", "FDI", "Lega")) %>%

  addControl(
    html = legend_list_roma$Turnout,
    position = "bottomright",
    className = "dynamic-legend"
  ) %>%

  onRender(
    "
    function(el, x, data) {
      var map = this;
      var legend = document.querySelector('.dynamic-legend');

      function updateLegend(groupName) {
        if (legend && data.legends[groupName]) {
          legend.innerHTML = data.legends[groupName];
        }
      }

      updateLegend('Turnout');

      map.on('baselayerchange', function(e) {
        updateLegend(e.name);
      });
    }
    ",
    data = list(legends = legend_list_roma)
  )

# 10) Save external HTML
saveWidget(
  roma_layers_dynamic,
  file.path(path_out, "interactive_map_roma_turnout_prrp_fdi_lega.html"),
  selfcontained = FALSE
)

roma_layers_dynamic
```
